sloka: ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः सोपाध्यायाः सहर्षिभिः ।तं देशं समुपाजग्मुर्यत्रेन्द्रो भयमोहितः ।। ७.८६.७ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ sopādhyāyāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।taṁ deśaṁ samupājagmuryatrendro bhayamohitaḥ ।। 7.86.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the hosts of gods, accompanied by their preceptors and sages, approached that place where Indra was deluded by fear.
